name: Troll Acolyte — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Troll Acolyte from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Troll Acolyte (CR 6)", "Troll Acolyte" but are not part of the Troll Acolyte entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Troll Acolyte (CR 6)

TROLL ACOLYTE
CR 6

In small troll groups, one member is singled out to safeguard the tribe members and the wilderness they call home. Such a troll might have magical power or simply knowledge of the natural world.

XP 2,400
Troll cleric 2
CE Large humanoid (giant)
